question: List the ID and sex of patients who are older than 60, were admitted to the hospital, and have at least two laboratory records showing abnormal alkaline phosphatase levels (ALP ≥ 300).

prediction.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT P.XCL_058, P.XCL_059
FROM Patient AS P
WHERE P.XCL_058 IN (
    SELECT E.XCL_001
    FROM Examination AS E
    WHERE E.XCL_013 > 0
) AND P.XCL_058 IN (
    SELECT L.XCL_014
    FROM Laboratory AS L
    WHERE L.XCL_048 >= 300
    GROUP BY L.XCL_014
    HAVING COUNT(L.XCL_014) >= 2
) AND (STRFTIME('%Y', 'now') - STRFTIME('%Y', P.XCL_060)) > 60

base_solution_anchor.base_sql:
SELECT P.XCL_058, P.XCL_059
FROM Patient P
INNER JOIN Examination E ON P.XCL_058 = E.XCL_001
INNER JOIN Laboratory L ON P.XCL_058 = L.XCL_014
WHERE P.XCL_060 < '1965-01-01'
  AND (E.XCL_005 & 16) = 16
  AND L.XCL_018 >= 300
GROUP BY P.XCL_058, P.XCL_059
HAVING COUNT(L.XCL_014) >= 2
